description: List the CyberBrick app's open windows: `openWindows` is the live truth (CDP page list with titles + hash routes), `storeWindows` is the window-state store's persisted id map (may be stale) — its ids are what window_close accepts. Also reports which window this MCP session is connected to (currentWindowId) and whether its editor has unsaved changes. Read-only.
name: window_list
title: List app windows
